description: A ground-level photograph depicts a sandy barrier or spit separating two bodies of water. To the right of the sandy landform, there is a wider expanse of open water, while to the left, a narrower, shallower channel with emergent wetland vegetation is visible. In the background, a dense line of trees forms the horizon under a clear blue sky. The sand on the barrier shows darker, potentially wet, patches. In the bottom left corner, partially obscured text reads "Copernicus Un[unreadable] SBL 01.tif". This image illustrates a typical coastal lagoon environment, consistent with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 521 (Coastal lagoons).
